name: Bennu
tagline: The most carefully tracked asteroid near Earth — sampled by OSIRIS-REx in 2020.
history: Bennu is a loosely bound rubble pile held together more by van der Waals forces than gravity — OSIRIS-REx's 2020 touch-and-go nearly sank into its surface and kicked up a spray of pebbles. The returned 121.6-gram sample is rich in carbon, hydrated clays and organic molecules. Bennu's orbit is also among the best-known collision risks: a 1-in-2,700 chance of Earth impact in 2182 — close enough to watch, far enough to sleep at night.
